rules.rule: Use strict Tailwind CSS v4 syntax, @import directives, and deterministic class ordering.
forbidden: bg-opacity-*
flex-shrink-*
flex-grow-*
overflow-ellipsis
@tailwind base/components/utilities
required: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "basecoat-css/vega";
bg-primary/80 (slash alpha)
shrink-0 / grow / text-ellipsis
Order: layout->flex/grid->size->space->type->bg->border->state

rules.rule: Respect .card 1px ring shadow and 4px/8px spacing scale; forbid arbitrary dimensions/colors.
forbidden: .card with border or border-border
w-[327px], h-[412px] (arbitrary bracket sizing)
bg-[#...], text-[rgb(...)], bg-gradient-*
gap-3, gap-5, p-5, p-7 (in comfortable mode)
required: class="card" (no border class)
spacing steps: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12 (compact adds 1, 1.5, 2.5, 3, 5)

rules.rule: Interactive primitives (dialog, dropdown-menu, accordion, tabs, navigation) require FSM data-state and ARIA bindings.
forbidden: Unbound interactive containers without data-state or data-fsm-*
import "basecoat-css/all"
required: dialog: <dialog class="dialog" data-state="closed" data-fsm-recipe="dialog" data-fsm-state="closed">
dropdown: <div class="dropdown-menu" data-state="closed"> + trigger aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="id"
accordion: <section class="accordion" data-state="open|closed"> using <details>/<summary>
tabs: <div class="tabs" data-state="active" data-fsm-recipe="tabs" data-fsm-state="active">

rules.rule: Enforce semantic tokens (--color-primary, --color-surface), WCAG/APCA contrast pairings, and html.dark resolver.
forbidden: Hardcoded hex (#fff, #09090b), rgb(), or w-[327px] in markup
Low-contrast pairings (bg-primary with text-primary)
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) mixed with .dark class
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
Custom localStorage theme keys other than "themeMode"
required: CSS variables: --color-primary (--primary), --color-surface (--background, --card), --foreground, --muted, --border
Paired classes: bg-primary + text-primary-foreground, bg-card + text-card-foreground, bg-background + text-foreground
Single theme resolver: window.basecoat.theme.toggle() + localStorage "themeMode"
Native <select> dark CSS: .dark select, .dark select option { background-color: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); color-scheme: dark; }

rules.rule: Use semantic HTML5 landmarks and native controls over generic <div> wrappers; forbid emojis and external CDNs.
forbidden: Generic <div> soup or duplicate wrapper <div> containers
Multiple <main> or multiple <h1> elements
Nested .card inside .card without data-variant="subcard"
Unicode emojis or external CDN <script>/<link>
required: Landmarks in order: <header>, <nav aria-label="...">, <main>, <aside aria-label="...">, <footer>
Forms: <div class="field"><label class="label" for="id"> + <input class="input" id="id">
Inline SVG icons (size-4, stroke="currentColor") and aria-label on icon buttons

rules.rule: Enforce KPI metric card typography hierarchy, tabular numerals, and semantic trend badge indicators.
forbidden: KPI numerals without tabular-nums (e.g. text-3xl font-semibold without tabular-nums)
Ambiguous trend percentages without semantic badge container or aria-label
.card with border or border-border in Vega style pack
required: Value typography: text-2xl or text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight tabular-nums
Trend indicator: Trend
Card padding: p-4 (compact) or p-6 (standard) without border class

rules.rule: Enforce data table geometry: overflow-x-auto wrapper, sticky header, toolbar, row actions, and tabular-nums.
forbidden: Bare <table> without <div class="overflow-x-auto"> wrapper container
Numeric columns without tabular-nums and text-right alignment
Interactive row action dropdown triggers without aria-expanded and data-state
required: Container: <div class="overflow-x-auto"><table class="table">
Sticky header: <thead class="sticky top-0 bg-background/90 backdrop-blur">
Toolbar: <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4"> above table
Row dropdowns with FSM contract: data-state="closed" aria-expanded="false"

rules.rule: Enforce form field wrappers with label association and data-state="loading" submit button handling.
forbidden: Native <input> without <div class="field"> and matching <label class="label" for="id">
Submit buttons without data-state / loading state handling during async submission
Hardcoded input sizes (e.g. w-[320px]); use w-full or responsive grid columns
required: Wrapper: <div class="field"><label class="label" for="id">Label</label><input class="input" id="id">
Submit action: <button type="submit" class="btn" data-state="default" data-loading-variant="spinner">

Validation helper:

bound via aria-describedby

rules.rule: Enforce sidebar and shell geometry with collapsible tooltip mode and compact top app bar.
forbidden: App headers with h-16 or taller in data-dense dashboards
Unlabelled <aside> or <nav> landmarks without aria-label or aria-labelledby
Sidebar container without data-state="expanded"|"collapsed" FSM contract
required: Sidebar: <aside class="sidebar group/sidebar" data-state="expanded" data-collapsible="tooltip" data-fsm-recipe="navigation" data-fsm-state="expanded" aria-label="Primary navigation">
Header: <header class="flex h-12 (or h-14) items-center justify-between border-b border-border/60">
Breadcrumb: <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" class="breadcrumb text-sm">

rules.rule: Forbid space-x-* and space-y-* utility classes; enforce flex gap-* or flex flex-col gap-*.
forbidden: space-x-* (legacy margin injection)
space-y-* (causes flex layout bleed)
required: flex gap-* (horizontal flex child spacing)
flex flex-col gap-* (vertical flex stack spacing)

rules.rule: Use modern Tailwind size-* utility instead of matching pairs of w-* and h-*.
forbidden: w-4 h-4 (redundant dimension pair)
required: size-4, size-8, size-10, size-12 shorthand utilities

rules.rule: Forbid manual dark: class overrides; rely exclusively on semantic CSS variables.
forbidden: dark:bg-slate-900 (manual dark class override)
dark:text-white, dark:border-zinc-800
required: Semantic CSS variables: bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, bg-card
HTML root .dark class managed by single theme controller

rules.rule: Forbid raw Tailwind palette colors (e.g. bg-blue-500, text-gray-600); enforce semantic theme tokens.
forbidden: bg-blue-500, bg-red-600, text-gray-600, bg-slate-100
Non-semantic color utilities outside badge semantic variants
required: bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground
bg-destructive, text-destructive-foreground, border-border

rules.rule: Enforce FieldGroup (data-component="field-group") and Field (data-component="field" / .field) with label association and dual data-invalid / aria-invalid contracts.
forbidden: Raw input stacked with label in plain space-y-* div
data-invalid on container without aria-invalid on input control
required: <div class="field" data-component="field"><label class="label" for="id">...<input class="input" id="id">
Dual invalid contract: container data-invalid="true" + control aria-invalid="true"

rules.rule: Enforce InputGroup structure (data-component="input-group") with explicit addons (data-slot="input-group-addon").
forbidden: Unstructured inline icons floating over inputs without input-group slot
Ad-hoc absolute positioned icon overlays inside raw text inputs
required: ...

rules.rule: Enforce grouped selections inside <optgroup>, SelectGroup, DropdownMenuGroup, or CommandGroup wrappers.
forbidden: Flat lists of options or menu items without categorical grouping
Ad-hoc divider divs separating option lists
required: <optgroup label="..."> in native <select>
<div data-slot="select-group" role="group"> with group label in custom menus

rules.rule: Enforce data-icon="inline-start|inline-end" on button icons without manual size-4 / w-4 h-4 classes.
forbidden: <button class="btn"><svg class="size-4" data-icon="inline-start"> (redundant sizing)
<button class="btn"><svg class="w-4 h-4"> (missing data-icon attribute)
required: <button class="btn"><svg data-icon="inline-start" ...> (automatic CSS sizing)
data-icon="inline-start" for leading icons, data-icon="inline-end" for trailing

rules.rule: Require DialogTitle / <h2> with aria-labelledby on <dialog>, drawer, and sheet overlays.
forbidden: <dialog class="dialog"> without aria-labelledby or visible accessible title
Sheet / drawer panels with missing modal title heading
required: Title

rules.rule: Require .empty state containers and .skeleton primitives instead of custom animate-pulse divs.
forbidden: Ad-hoc <div class="animate-pulse bg-gray-200"> loading placeholders
Empty table/card fallback without .empty landmark structure
required: <div class="skeleton h-4 w-full"> or <div class="skeleton size-10 rounded-full">
No records

rules.rule: Reject orphaned <input>, <select>, <textarea> controls without an enclosing Field (.field) or FieldGroup (.field-group / <fieldset>).
forbidden: Orphaned <input> controls without ancestor .field, .field-group, or <fieldset>
Bare <textarea> or <select> elements outside semantic form containers
required: ......

rules.rule: Enforce explicit for / id matching between <label> and control, and aria-describedby linking to description/error nodes.
forbidden: <label> with missing or mismatched for attribute inside .field
Control missing aria-describedby when .field-description or .field-error is present
required: <label class="label" for="email">Email</label><input id="email" class="input" aria-describedby="email-desc email-err">

...

...

rules.rule: Enforce FieldSet (<fieldset>) + FieldLegend (<legend>) for multiple related radio/checkbox controls.
forbidden: Multiple <input type="radio"> or checkbox controls without an enclosing <fieldset>
<fieldset> containers missing an accessible <legend> element
required:
Choice
...

rules.rule: SVG and canvas charts require a companion accessible data table <table class="sr-only"> for screen readers.
forbidden: Bare SVG or canvas chart containers without accessible text/table fallback
Charts with missing role="img" or missing accessible label
required: ...

rules.rule: Responsive SVG charts must define viewBox and bind a ResizeObserver container without fixed pixel dimensions.
forbidden: SVG charts with hardcoded width="600" height="400" without viewBox
Unresponsive chart canvases that cause horizontal viewport overflow
required: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 300" class="w-full h-auto"> with container ResizeObserver binding

rules.rule: Navigation links within sidebar and breadcrumbs must indicate active route via aria-current="page".
forbidden: Active navigation links marked only with CSS visual classes (e.g. bg-muted font-bold)
Multiple conflicting aria-current="page" items in the same navigation scope
required: Dashboard

rules.rule: Collapsible sidebars in icon mode must specify data-collapsible="icon" and render tooltips for icon-only buttons.
forbidden: Sidebar collapsing to icon-only without data-collapsible="icon"
Icon-only collapsed sidebar buttons without accessible tooltip or sr-only label
required: <aside class="sidebar" data-collapsible="icon"> with <span class="sr-only"> on icon actions

rules.rule: Inset sidebar layouts must define data-variant="inset" on the sidebar container.
forbidden: Inset sidebar layouts with ad-hoc margins instead of canonical variant attribute
Conflicting layout variants on the primary navigation shell
required: <aside class="sidebar" data-variant="inset">

rules.rule: KPI scale ticks, gauges, and comparison delta percentages must apply tabular-nums for layout stability.
forbidden: Dynamic metric numbers or delta badges rendered with proportional numerals
Flickering layouts caused by fluctuating numeral glyph widths
required: tabular-nums utility on all dynamic counts, percentages, and metrics

rules.rule: Icon-only action buttons without text content must provide an explicit aria-label or <span class="sr-only">.
forbidden: <button class="btn"><svg ... /></button> with empty accessible text
Buttons with only title attribute (unreliable for screen readers)
required: <button class="btn" aria-label="Delete item"><svg ... /></button>

rules.rule: SVG charts and data visualizations must strictly reference CSS variables var(--chart-1) through var(--chart-5).
forbidden: Hardcoded stroke="#3b82f6" or fill="rgb(59, 130, 246)" on chart paths
Arbitrary non-standard chart color palettes outside theme tokens
required: stroke="var(--chart-1)", fill="var(--chart-2)" up to var(--chart-5)

rules.rule: Accordion items using native <details> must synchronize data-state="open" or data-state="closed" attributes.
forbidden: <details class="accordion"> without dynamic data-state synchronization
Accordion headers without keyboard expand/collapse support
required: <details class="accordion" data-state="open|closed"> with <summary class="accordion-trigger">

rules.rule: Status badges and icon-only indicator chips must provide accessible text via <span class="sr-only">.
forbidden: Colored status dots (<span class="size-2 rounded-full bg-green-500">) without screen reader text
Visual-only indicators that fail accessibility audits
required: Active statusActive

rules.rule: Table pagination bars must be enclosed in <nav aria-label="Pagination"> with aria-disabled="true" on disabled controls.
forbidden: Pagination controls rendered as a flat div soup without nav landmark
Disabled previous/next buttons lacking aria-disabled attribute
required: <nav aria-label="Pagination" class="pagination flex items-center justify-between">
